Treatment not coordinated through the network; referral service</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Covered services for treatment of mental illness are paid at a constant fifty percent (50%) of usual and customary charges to a maximum of twenty (20) inpatient days and twenty (20) outpatient visits each year if the services are certified as covered by the network&#x27;s referral service.</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Covered services for treatment of mental illness are paid at a constant fifty percent (50%) of usual and customary charges to the thirty (30)-day inpatient and thirty (30)-visit outpatient limits if not coordinated through the plan.</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>8. Treatment of substance abuse</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'></td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'></td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>a. Treatment coordinated through the network; referral service</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Covered services for inpatient and outpatient treatment of substance abuse are paid at ninety-five percent (95%) of allowed charges.</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Covered services for inpatient and outpatient treatment of substance abuse are paid at full if services are coordinated through the plan.</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>b. Treatment not coordinated through the network; referral service</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Covered services for inpatient and outpatient treatment of substance abuse are paid at a constant fifty percent (50%) of usual and customary charges.</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Covered services for inpatient and outpatient treatment of substance abuse are paid at a constant fifty percent (50%) of usual and customary charges if services are not coordinated through the plan.</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>c. Benefit maximum</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Benefits are paid to a lifetime maximum of two courses of treatment. Each course of treatment not coordinated through the referral service is subject to a $5,000 maximum.</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Benefits are paid to a lifetime maximum of two courses of treatment or $10,000, if greater. Each course of treatment not coordinated through the plan is subject to a $5,000 maximum.</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>9. Neurodevelopmental therapy</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Covered services for neurodevelopmental therapy for children age six or younger are paid at network and non-network levels to a maximum of $1,000 each year.</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Varies by plan.</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>10. Treatment of TMJ and MPDS</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Covered services for treatment of TMJ and MPDS are paid at a constant fifty percent (50%) of usual and customary charges to a $3,500 lifetime maximum.</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Varies by plan.</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>11. Smoking cessation treatment</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Covered services and supplies are paid at one hundred percent (100%) of usual and customary charges to a $500 lifetime maximum.</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Varies by plan.</td></tr></table>
